title: Helmet of Grit

sources.title: Grit
markers: | description = When the wearer has 50% [[Hit Points]] or less, they have an additional {{r|Bonus}}.

summary: Gain +1 Dexterity saves and an additional Bonus Action while at or below half HP.

fields.Base value: 360 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Grit: At or below half maximum HP, gain an extra Bonus Action. Temporary HP counts toward the threshold. The pinned source reports that crossing down to the threshold again can grant another Bonus Action in the same turn. It stacks with other Bonus Action sources.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
